DitherTheme.background: The page background. Components fade towards it and the text effects hide cells with it.
DitherTheme.foreground: The text colour, and the base of every soft border and fill.
DitherTheme.ink: The default colour of dithered ink.
DitherTheme.animated: Turns motion on or off everywhere. Components read it as the default for their own animated.

DitherMotion.hover: The default hover effect of every component.
DitherMotion.press: The default press effect of every component.
DitherMotion.idle: The default idle effect of every component.
DitherMotion.matrix: The dither pattern of the motion effects.
DitherMotion.speed: Multiplies the speed of every motion effect.
DitherMotion.intensity: Multiplies the strength of every motion effect.
